follow-up time: Until discharge or after discharge for those who developed rebound bilirubin
cohort: 275 neonates admitted to the neonatal care unit at Babylon Teaching Hospital for Maternity and Pediatrics between April and December 2016 who received intensive phototherapy for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.
finding: Significant bilirubin rebound occurred in 10.9% of neonates treated with intensive phototherapy, and the most significant risk factors were onset of jaundice before 60 hours of life, Rh incompatibility, and birth weight less than 2.5 kg.
